name: Latent-NeRF
definition: Applies score distillation to a latent diffusion model and the compact latent space of a pre-trained autoencoder to optimize NeRF.
summary: Latent-NeRF optimizes Neural Radiance Fields by mapping outputs to a latent space decoded by a pre-trained diffusion model, using score distillation for high-fidelity textures instead of direct RGB prediction.
